text:
Maya: Quick sync — I'm starting the canary for the per-route / per-model filter in Console. Main open questions: 1) how do we surface quota burn for saved queries vs ephemeral previews, 2) routing hint visibility for Dedicated vs Hosted variants, 3) UX for fallback routing when model unavailable. Thoughts?
Sam: nice. I think quota should show a token estimate + current route quota remaining. small badge on saved queries and ephemeral previews.
Kevin: Agree. Also we should surface the fallback model variant explicitly (e.g., rdx-7b-quant -> rdx-4b-8bit) so users know quality delta. Tooltip with rules works.
Natalie: Is there a stable API contract for these routing hints? frontend needs deterministic label keys.
Sam: there's a draft in internal-api/routes.md — fields: model_priority[], fallback_policy, quota_scope. names are messy though.
Kevin: Can we add a `quota_preview_estimate` to GET /routes? frontend wants a single numeric for the preview card.
Maya: That helps. Any perf concerns computing estimates for every route on list pages?
Sam: compute async and cache per-prefix. show a skeleton while computing. for orgs with >1M tokens/day maybe skip heavy estimates during canary.
deploy-bot: Deployment started: per-route-filter-canary v1.2 -> infra-prod (canary=10%).
Natalie: UX nit: saved queries that reference multiple routes — show per-route quota rows + an aggregated total? users will be confused if only aggregated.
Kevin: Per-route breakdown + aggregated total in the header. also annotate which route will fallback to a cheaper model under low quota.
Maya: Action items: Sam -> add `quota_preview_estimate` to GET /routes; Kevin -> add fallback label strings to model catalog + mapping table; Natalie -> draft wire for saved-query per-route breakdown. I'll make a quick mock and post in #product-design.
Sam: on it, ETA EOD.
Kevin: I'll review the mock and wire up the catalog labels. :thumbsup: 
Maya: tagging @eng-sre to monitor canary for routing/fallback errors.
eng-sre-bot: Alert subscription added for per-route-filter-canary errors (threshold: 5 failures / 5m).
Maya: thanks — will follow up with the mock link once it's uploaded.
